    o.operbotdetref as robot_det_ref,
    SUM(o.progcyclecount) as tpc,
    SUM(o.cycletimesecval) as total_cycle_time,
    SUM(o.progcyclecount) * 1.0 / SUM(o.cycletimesecval) as oce
FROM operation o
GROUP BY o.operbotdetref
LIMIT 10;

-- Compute OCE per robot per program
SELECT 
    o.operbotdetref as robot_det_ref,
    o.currprogval as program,
    SUM(o.progcyclecount) as tpc,
    SUM(o.cycletimesecval) as total_cycle_time,
    SUM(o.progcyclecount) * 1.0 / SUM(o.cycletimesecval) as program_oce
FROM operation o
GROUP BY o.operbotdetref, o.currprogval
LIMIT 10;

-- Compute average program OCE and rank
SELECT 
    currprogval as program,
    AVG(program_oce) as avg_program_oce
FROM (
    SELECT 
        o.operbotdetref as robot_det_ref,
        o.currprogval,
        SUM(o.progcyclecount) * 1.0 / SUM(o.cycletimesecval) as program_oce
    FROM operation o
    GROUP BY o.operbotdetref, o.currprogval
) sub
GROUP BY currprogval
ORDER BY avg_program_oce DESC
LIMIT 10;

    -- OCE and TPC per robot
    SELECT 
        o.operbotdetref as robot_det_ref,
        SUM(o.progcyclecount) as tpc,
        SUM(o.cycletimesecval) as total_cycle_time,
        SUM(o.progcyclecount) * 1.0 / SUM(o.cycletimesecval) as oce
    FROM operation o
    GROUP BY o.operbotdetref
),
program_oce AS (
    -- Program-level OCE per robot
    SELECT 
        o.operbotdetref as robot_det_ref,
        o.currprogval as program,
        SUM(o.progcyclecount) * 1.0 / SUM(o.cycletimesecval) as program_oce
    FROM operation o
    GROUP BY o.operbotdetref, o.currprogval
),
avg_program_oce AS (
    -- Average OCE per program across robots
    SELECT 
        program,
        AVG(program_oce) as avg_program_oce
    FROM program_oce
    GROUP BY program
),
ranked_programs AS (
    -- Rank programs by their average OCE
    SELECT 
        program,
        avg_program_oce,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(program_oce) DESC) as program_efficiency_rank

    GROUP BY program, avg_program_oce
